newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-THREATENING CALLS MADE TO IRVINE'S FAMILY.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-THREATENING CALLS MADE TO IRVINE'S FAMILY.

text.p: Briton Eddie Irvine's family received threatening calls after the Irish, and not the British, flag was raised on his podium finish at the Argentine Grand Prix.
Ferrari driver Irvine told a news conference on Thursday on the eve of the San Marino Grand Prix that he hoped to find a solution to the problem of being a Northern Ireland-born Britain.
"The Tricolour being raised in Argentina (on April 13) caused my parents problems and people who work for me," said Irvine.
"I want a neutral flag to be raised which is what I am working on. I'd like the Shamrock raised and then the Londonderry Air played if I won."
